edits.new: A mask is a set of selected text fragments. The mask section presents one quoted fragment per line. The marked_post section shows their original occurrences within the complete post, enclosed in ⟦ and ⟧.
edits.old: A mask is a set of selected text fragments. The mask section presents them together. The marked_post section shows their original occurrences within the complete post. In both views, ⟦ and ⟧ enclose selected text.
